title: Manyhands JSON v1 document or ticket
description: A nonconforming entry has a null id and null metadata. In a list, body, source and observation are null. A ticket's slug, parent and deps are its own fields and are not repeated in unknown_metadata. readiness is null for a document and for a nonconforming entry.

publication.description: Set only by a complete read of a closing ticket in a pull-request repository: published when the ticket at the remote tracking ref of its branch holds the same closure, pending otherwise, including when there is no tracking ref. Null for any other state, in direct mode and in every list.

parent.description: The ticket's parent, in the shape of a dependency.

readiness.description: closed for a ticket whose primary copy has closure metadata. An open ticket is ready when every dependency is a closed ticket, and blocked otherwise: a closed dependency never blocks, whatever it depends on, and a closing one does. A closing ticket is decided as an open one is. reasons is empty unless it is blocked.

pull_request.description: The pull request link this clone gave a ticket or a document. Set only by a complete read (show, and show --path) of a ticket that has one, or of a document read from its active context that has one while the primary does not hold the document; null in every list, for a document with no link, with no active context or held by the primary, and for a ticket without a link.

unknown_metadata.description: Front matter keys Manyhands does not define. Any JSON value may appear under a key.
